command:
set -euo pipefail
TMP=$(mktemp -d /tmp/omega777-finalize.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TMP"' EXIT
git clone -q https://github.com/gschaidergabriel/frankenstein.git "$TMP/frankenstein"
cd "$TMP/frankenstein"
git checkout -q chatgpt-gpt56sol-777-local-voice-bootstrap-20260912
echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
echo MAIN=$(git rev-parse origin/main)
python3 -m py_compile scripts/omega_arm_bus.py scripts/voice777_pocket_renderer.py scripts/voice777_local_audio_arm.py scripts/voice777_omni_presence.py scripts/omega_organ_activity.py scripts/voice_777_runtime.py scripts/voice_host_777_live_client.py scripts/frank_terminal_777.py
python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_omega_arm_bus.py tests/test_voice777_pocket_renderer.py tests/test_voice777_local_audio_arm.py tests/test_voice777_omni_presence.py tests/test_voice777_multiarm_integration.py tests/test_omega_organ_activity.py
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
echo OMEGA_INTEGRATION_STATIC_AND_UNIT_PASS
